account: Today has felt unusually quiet and somewhat disjointed, though I have no proof of anything secret. I had heard reports of lights or decorations at the bakery. The baker denied arranging decorations or a celebration and said he had been baking; an oven glowing is a plausible explanation. He also offered to supply bread if the town plans a gathering. Two residents at the hall reported that the innkeeper carried a sack of bread at market. That could mean guests or a gathering, but I have not verified either, and ordinary inn business could explain it. No account papers were presented at my scheduled accounts appointment. The secretary spent time checking my tea invitation unnecessarily because my confirmation had not reached her; we eventually cleared that up. I am now visiting the neighbour at the dockside cottage, as scheduled. The neighbour has offered no fresh quay news and repeated the baker's explanation. I suspect there may be some activity I have not heard about, possibly hospitality or a gathering involving bread, but that remains speculation, not an established connection between the baker, innkeeper, and neighbour. I should keep my 16:30 office appointment and seek firsthand information rather than spread rumours.
